# Usage of oc and kubectl commands {#usage-oc-kubectl}

Because OpenShift Container Platform is a certified Kubernetes distribution, you can use the Kubernetes CLI (`kubectl`) that ships with OpenShift Container Platform to interact with your cluster. You can also gain extended functionality specific to OpenShift Container Platform by using the {{ oc_first }} binary.
